title: Production of AAV Virus by Iodixanol Gradient Ultracentrifugation
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science

steps_raw.instruction: Production of AAV Virus by Iodixanol Gradient Ultracentrifugation
Scope and Applicability: This protocol can be used to produce AAV of any serotype with high purity and high titer.
HEK293T cells: (ATCC CRL-11268)
Serotype-specific Rep-Cap Plasmid
Polyethylenimine (PEI) linear MW 25,000 (Polysciences 23966 or equivalent)

Warning: Personal Protective Equipment () should be used at all times while operating this protocol. If you are unsure what you should be using, see your immediate supervisor.
Prepare DMEM with 10% FBS and 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic by adding 50 mL of FBS and 5 mL of Antibiotic-Antimycotic to 500 mL of DMEM, and store at 4ºC
Prepare DMEM with 4% FBS and 1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic
1 mg/ml Polyethylenimine, linear MW 25,000 Da (PEI)
7.3.1 Dissolve 1 mg of PEI (Polysciences 23966) in 1 mL of PBS
7.3.2	Adjust to a pH between 4 and 5 with 12N HCl
7.3.3	Sterilize the solution by passing through a 0.22 µm filter unit;
7.3.4 Aliquot and store the solution at -20ºC
7.3.5	Keep the working solution at 4ºC
Prepare 10X Gradient Buffer (GB) (100 mL)
10 mL 1M Tris (pH 7.6)
Filter sterilize using 0.22 µm vacuum filter system
Prepare 15% Iodixanol gradient solution (100 mL)
25 mL Optiprep (60%) Iodixanol solution
Mix Iodixanol solution well and store at 4ºC.
Prepare 25% Iodixanol gradient solution (70 mL)
29.2 mL Optiprep (60%) Iodixanol solution
Mix Iodixanol solution well and store at 4ºC.
Prepare 40% Iodixanol gradient solution (150 mL)
100 mL Optiprep (60%) Iodixanol solution
Mix Iodixanol solution well and store at 4ºC.
Prepare 60% Iodixanol (150 mL)
150 mL Optiprep (60%) Iodixanol solution
Mix Iodixanol solution well and store at 4ºC.
Prepare washing buffer
Methodology/Procedures:
Transient transfection of 293T cells

Seed 2 × 107 293 cells in 15 cm dishes to achieve ∼70% to 80% confluency the next morning (split confluent 15 cm plates of cells 1:2 into 15 cm plates). Cells are maintained in complete DMEM/10% FBS/1% anti-anti and split before reaching confluency by trypsinizing with TrypLE. Each plate contains 20 mL of culture medium.
Ten plates are required for a large-scale production. The number of plates can be scaled based on the production scale.
For transfection of 10, 15 cm dishes, combine the following in a 15 mL polystyrene tube:
105 μg Serotype-specific Rep-Cap Plasmid
105 μg rAAV vector plasmid
190 μg pHelper plasmid
Add 5 mL of OptiMEM to the tube, and mix by vortex briefly for 5 seconds.
Add 1.1 mL of PEI to the mixture, vortex briefly for 5 seconds, and incubate 5-10 min at room temperature.
Add 0.61 mL of mixture from step 8.1.6 dropwise to the medium in each and swirl the medium to disperse evenly
Change the medium to 20 mL of DMEM/4%FBS/1% Antibiotic-Antimycotic 24 hr post-transfection, and incubate the cells until 72 hr post-transfection
At 72 hr post-transfection, each plate of cells is scraped using a cell scraper, and the mixture of cells and culture medium is transferred to a 50 mL tube.
Cell pellets are collected after centrifugation at 500 x g at 4ºC for 15 min
Remove supernatant, resuspend cells in 10 mL of 1X gradient buffer, mix by pipetting and freeze the 50 mL tube in dry ice in an ice bucket.
Thaw cells in a 37ºC water bath, and freeze/thaw 3 more times using dry ice and water bath.
After the last thaw, add 50 U/mL Benzonase to the suspension and incubate at 37ºC for 30 min (2.6 µL of enzyme/10 mL)
Centrifuge the 50 mL tube at 3,000 x g for 15 min at 4ºC and collect supernatant.
Supernatant can be frozen at -80ºC or purified directly.
Iodixanol gradient purification.

Build an iodixanol gradient in Beckman Polycarbonate Bottle with Cap Assembly. The 4 layers of iodixanol gradient solutions from the bottom of the tube to the top are 60% (3mL), 40% (3mL), 25% (3.5mL), and 15% (6mL).

Start by adding the 15% solution to the bottom of the Beckman tube using serological pipets, and add subsequent layers below the previous layer, 25%, 40% and 60%, by using a 10 mL syringe with the Hamilton metal hub needle. Place the needle to just above the bottom of the Beckman tube and slowly inject.

Add the Benzonase-treated supernatant to the gradient by slowly dripping the solution onto the top layer of the gradient. For 10, 15 cm plates, we usually obtain 10 mL of Benzonase-treated supernatant, which can be divided into 2 tubes for gradient purification. The tubes can be balanced using gradient buffer.
Close the top of the tubes and centrifuge the tubes at 58,000 rpm in a Beckman Type 70Ti rotor for 90 min at 18ºC.
Add 5 mL wash buffer to Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal filter unit and spin at 3000 g to prime filter

Carefully move the tubes back to the hood and extract about 4mL of solution using a 10 mL syringe with the Hamilton metal hub needle and inserting the needle approximately 1-2 mm below the interface between the 40% and 60% gradient buffer layers.

The collected solution is transferred to a primed Amicon Ultra-15 centrifugal filter unit, added with washing buffer and centrifuged at 3,000 rpm at 4ºC. The final volume is reduced to 150 µL after sufficient washing.
Viral samples should be aliquoted and stored at -80ºC for long term storage.
Clean the hood with 70% Ethanol after use.
The biohazard waste generated during the process is disposed according to the biohazard waste procedure guidelines.
The aluminum caps of the Polycarbonate Bottle with Cap Assembly (Beckman, cat. no. 355618) can be autoclaved, but the bottles are discarded after each use.
Technical Information:
Tubes containing iodixanol gradient and AAV lysate need to be weighted before loading to the ultracentrifuge. The difference in weight between tubes is controlled to be less than 0.05 g.
The purification process can be temporarily stopped at step 8.1.10 when cell pellet is collected and can be kept at -80ºC, and at step 8.1.15 when AAV cell lysate can be kept at -80ºC.

If a fluorescent reporter is part of the AAV design, check the transfection efficiency using an epifluorescence microscope. The transfection efficiency should be around 70-80% or higher in order to obtain high titer of AAV.
